title: Thailand Couple Escape
headline: Bangkok temples, then Phuket and a night among the islands.
description: Six nights for two: three in Bangkok, three on Phuket, with a Phi Phi or Phang Nga day on the Andaman.
image_alt: Tropical beach and turquoise water along the Thai Andaman coast
price_label: Quoted for your dates and hotels
price_guidance: Thailand pricing depends on hotel category, island day-boat and whether you add Krabi or Pattaya. We confirm a written total before you reserve.
overview: A honeymoon-paced Thailand: city first, sea second. Three nights in Bangkok for temples, river evenings and dining, then fly south for Phuket beaches and one shared or private island day. Built for two, without a group timetable.
highlights: Three nights in Bangkok with a Chao Phraya river evening.
Grand Palace or Wat Arun timed around the heat of the day.
Three nights on Phuket for beach time and a sunset dinner.
One Andaman island day — Phi Phi or Phang Nga — as quoted.
why: City and islands in one week, without packing every night.
Vegetarian and Jain dining can be flagged to hotels in advance.
Visa-exemption or e-visa guidance for Indian passports, with your tickets.
inclusions: Airport and hotel transfers in a private vehicle
One island day tour as specified in your quote
exclusions: Thailand visa or exemption processing fees if they apply
Optional massages, cabaret or national-park tickets unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees
